  PROBLEM: When Telegram cannot send (no TG_BOT_SECRET or chat id, or ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=SILENT), the marker is never posted, so every later round on that head repeats the dedupe reads (/user, the issue, the newest page), which wastes GitHub API calls (§14).
  WHY: Suggested fix is to guard the read with "type tg_alert_configured >/dev/null 2>&1 && tg_alert_configured CRITICAL" (tg_helpers.sh:106-112) and otherwise leave RB_SECURITY_HOLD_REPEAT=unchecked; about 3 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.

  PROBLEM: The test only greps the workflow for the literal `AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET="" gh api ...` line and never runs the shim with an emptied secret. The empty-secret fall-through is tested only for activation (tests/test_comment_signature.py:200-202), not for a shim already on PATH that gets an emptied secret at call time (gh_helpers.sh:139-141).
  WHY: Not a current runtime failure; it is a missing regression guard.
